title: Grading Trims & Objs | Clo Feature Deep Dive
description:
Learn all about the updates to our Grading feature in CLO 2024.2 that allows you to easily grade trims (OBJ files). Check out other new features here: https://clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord-
